Today looked busy with several tasks on your agenda. You started by checking the weather forecast, which predicted a sunny day with high temperatures. After reviewing your calendar, you had lunch plans at 12:30 PM with your team.

You also took some time to catch up on personal matters. I set a reminder for you to post Hannah's Christmas present on Thursday and noted that you went for a 15-minute walk around the block after lunch. 

Additionally, you worked on getting into some reading material. You started the book Hannah lent you and made a note to finish chapter three tonight.

I was able to help with dinner ideas as well. When you asked about using halloumi and capsicum, I suggested a tray bake that works well with these ingredients.

You also touched base with your own personal development goals, adding "Upgrade the logging library" to your Platform Cleanup note - this one is already on there, but it's good that you're keeping an eye on it.

It seems like you're looking forward to some pleasant weather and are enjoying Hannah's company.
